description: "Use when creating or modifying the simple Todo web app in todo-app/. Enforces plain HTML, CSS, and JavaScript with strict scope control."
name: "Todo Web Scope"
applyTo: "todo-app/**"
---

# Todo Web App Rules

- Build only the features defined in [docs/user-story.md](../../docs/user-story.md).
- Use plain HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
- Keep UI and logic simple, readable, and local to the page.
- Do not add completion status, persistence, network calls, backend code, or extra Todo metadata.
- If a requested change exceeds add, edit, or delete behavior, flag it as scope creep.
